name: FasterARK
long_description: The top-level `Makefile` downloads the required assets from the latest ARK-5, Time Machine, CustomIPL, Launcher-Menus, PSP dynamic-libraries, and DC10 releases into `tmp/`. Time Machine supplies the Vita installer assets and the DC and ARK-150 assets used by the updater. Run `make clean` to remove these temporary downloads. Building requires network access, `curl`, and `unzip`.
